svg.title: 6 vector databases x 8 industry indexes
svg.desc: Grid of six vector databases by eight industry indexes, 48 indexes in total, with the tenant isolation mechanism of each database. Postgres-style system of record holds sources and quarantine; every vector index is rebuildable.
svg.text: One versioned index per industry, tenants isolated inside it. Every query pre-filters tenant · ACL · status · validity in the DB.
HC healthcare · BK banking · IN insurance · LG legal · RT retail · MF manufacturing · GV government · ED education_hr

g.text: ● enforced / indexed by the DB▲ filter-only, flagged in 99_compare
Postgres in 01 · SQLite per notebook (data/sor/) · every vector index is rebuildable from it
